shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- vite-env ---\\n' && cat src/vite-env.d.ts && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat tsconfig.json && cat vite.config.ts && cat index.html && npm ls @gravity-ui/chartkit --depth=0 2>/dev/null || true'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"defaultPlugins|renderPlugin|ChartKit|register|lazy|dispatch\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs -g '*.md' | sed -n '1,180p'; printf '\\n--- package files ---\\n'; node -p \"require('@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json').version\"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n '1,60p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '35,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- entry types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- components type ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts; printf '\\n--- d.ts refs ---\\n'; rg -n \"gravity-charts|yagr\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- widget types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts; printf '\\n--- plugin exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"export|Plugin\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- package exports ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build -path '*types*' -name '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,80p'; rg -n \"export type ChartData|declare type ChartData|interface ChartData|type ChartSeriesData|series:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"console.log(require.resolve('@gravity-ui/charts'))\" 2>/dev/null || true; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed -n '1,30p'; rg -n \"export type ChartData|interface ChartData|type ChartSeriesData|series:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules -type d -path '*gravity-ui*' -maxdepth 4 | sort | sed -n '1,80p'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.js; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -name '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,40p'; rg -n \"export type ChartData|interface ChartData|type ChartSeriesData|series:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p'; rg -n \"export type YagrWidgetData|interface YagrWidgetData|type YagrWidgetData|timeline\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/types/index.d.ts; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist -type f -path '*chart/line*' | sort; rg -n \"LineSeries|type: 'line'|type: \\\"line\\\"\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/types -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,60p'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '90,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/types/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/types/chart/base.d.ts; rg -n \"type RawSerieData|interface RawSerieData|export.*RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/typings -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,30p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"type RawSerieData|interface RawSerieData|export.*RawSerieData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/typings -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg -n \"type.*SERIES_TYPE|enum SERIES_TYPE|Line =\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/constants* node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/Loader/Loader.js; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/Loader -type f -maxdepth 2 -print; rg -n \"@gravity-ui/uikit\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components -g '*.js' | head -20; rg -n \"export.*SegmentedRadioGroup|export.*Segmented\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/dashboard-visualization-widget.tsx
@@
-import {ChartKit, settings} from '@gravity-ui/chartkit';
+import ChartKit, {settings} from '@gravity-ui/chartkit';
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "cat src/dashboard-visualization-widget.tsx && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- git diff --stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat 2>/dev/null || true"
